title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Guy. Part 3
body: He talks about his plans, never his savings. He says "I'll take care of everything" and asks you to book the table. He splits the bill to the last rupee, then says he is not materialistic. He borrowed five hundred rupees in March and forgot. Every business idea is "can't tell you yet." The business is a Canva logo.
caption:
Tag the friend who says he is different.

title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Girl. Part 3
body: Every sentence starts with "my friend's husband." Her friend's husband planned a surprise. Her cousin's fiance bought a car. Her neighbour's boyfriend writes poetry. Your relationship is a group project where everyone else has already submitted and you are still looking for the file.
caption:
Send this to him. Anonymously.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in a Rishta Meeting. Part 3
body: The tray enters with six cups and twelve people watching. Everyone says "no need to take the trouble" and watches how you walk. You studied for years, and the real exam is carrying a tray without spilling. The tray has more pressure than your whole degree.
caption:
Tag the friend who survived this exact meeting.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Maybe Zone. Part 3
body: She says "we should hang out sometime." Sometime is not a day. It is a country that does not exist. You wait three months for sometime to become Saturday. It never does. Sometime is a polite lie with a calendar. Put a date on it or let it go.
caption:
Tag the one who is stuck in the maybe zone.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags on a First Date. Part 3
body: He asks your salary, your father's profession and your family's property by dessert. It is a first date, not a bank loan. He says "I'm just curious" and writes it on his forehead. Ask him the same questions back. Watch how fast curiosity becomes a security issue.
caption:
Send this before your next date.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags When He Texts. Part 3
body: Texts only, never calls. "I'm bad at calls." He is not bad at calls. He is bad at being caught. He sends four minute voice notes about nothing and a text when you ask a question. He can talk for ten minutes but never to your face, and never when it matters.
caption:
Tag the friend who is waiting for a reply.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Her Emotional Support Contact. Part 3
body: She says "you're like a brother to me" right after sharing her heartbreak. And you stay for the next episode. A brother who also holds her chai while she cries and nods like a professional. The brother zone has a very long waiting list and nobody has ever left.
caption:
Send this to someone who always listens and never gets asked.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Never Date a Playboy. Part 3
body: He is never free on Fridays and weekends. "Family time." His family seems to have a lot of events in a lot of cities. His cousin's wedding is the cover story every single week. His phone is on silent from Friday night to Sunday afternoon. That is the roster.
caption:
Send this to the friend who says he's changed.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in His Instagram. Part 3
body: He likes your photo from the very bottom, then unlikes it. He follows girls with names like zara_xo_88 and comments "wow" on four of them. He says "I don't have time for social media" but knows who unfollowed whom in your whole friend group.
caption:
Send this to a friend who is stalking his profile.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Taxi Light Theory. Part 3
body: Do not waste your time convincing a man who is not ready. You can be the best cook, the best listener, the best degree. He will find reasons: timing, career, family. When he is ready, he does not need a reason. When he is not, a reason is all he has left.
caption:
Send this to someone who thinks it was their fault.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Who Has to Approve Your Marriage. Part 3
body: Mama says "whatever you want." It means whatever she wants. Papa says "it's your life," then asks about their land. Nana says "in our time" and the committee goes quiet for two hours. Nobody takes minutes. Everyone takes sides, and the biryani gets cold.
caption:
Send this to the family group chat. We dare you.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Find a Spiritual Partner. Part 3
body: Everything is "toxic." Your friends are toxic, your mother's call is toxic, your question "where were you" is a trauma response. He has read a lot and listened to nobody. He has a word for every feeling and an apology for none of them. That is not growth. That is vocabulary.
caption:
Send this to someone who is healing at your expense.

title: 🚩 How to Read a Rishta Profile. Part 3
body: "Business" on a boy's profile. Business of what? "Import export." Of what? "Various things." Various things means he sells phone covers on OLX. Annual profit: his mother's Eid money. His father calls it a growing empire. Everyone nods.
caption:
Tag the friend whose biodata needs a rewrite.
